title: Build, clone and compare short strings
summary: Build a string value from a slice (mostly short ASCII, with some longer and some non-ASCII strings), clone it and compare the clone with a second value built from another slice.
notes: Rust only. Each call builds the library's string type from the text, clones it, builds a second value from the fixture's second string (equal in half the cases), compares the clone with it, and returns the clone and the comparison result.
